documentTitle: What one Meta ad can carry: the real limits

slides.headline: What one Meta ad can actually carry.
Shapes, one ad
slides.footer: Placement asset customisation serves each placement its own file.

slides.headline: Catch 1
slides.body: Multiple texts and placement-specific files can't share one creative. Meta refuses it ("Multiple bodies assets cannot be applied to rule no. 1"). Split it: one ad per text, each keeping every shape.
mono: "Multiple bodies assets cannot be applied to rule no. 1"

slides.headline: Catch 2
slides.body: I supplied a 1:1 next to a 4:5. It uploaded fine and was never served. I only found out by reading the creative back from Meta.
slides.takeaway: Always read back what you built.
